# Revision History

> Searchable, verifiable archive of 63,623 anonymous Wikipedia edits made from Government of Canada networks, 2008–2025: Parliament, National Defence, Shared Services Canada and more. Published by Prime Rogue Inc. Data built 2026-11-14.

## Key facts

- 63,623 edits from 1,327 IP addresses, 2 January 2008 to 3 November 2025.
- Sources: English and French Wikipedia, Wikidata, Wikimedia Commons, English Wiktionary, English Wikivoyage.
- Edits are those made without logging in, where Wikipedia published the editor's IP address.
- Networks: the @gccaedits department range list plus Shared Services Canada's routed prefixes (AS2665, AS2675, AS2682, AS25689, AS806).
- The archive ends on 3 November 2025, because English Wikipedia replaced public IP attribution with temporary accounts on 4 November 2025.
- Every data pull is checksummed (SHA-256), hash-chained and timestamped in Bitcoin with OpenTimestamps.
- Important caveat: An edit from a government network is not evidence of who made it, or that it was made in an official capacity. Most addresses are shared gateways used by hundreds or thousands of people.
- Edits are attributed to networks, never to named individuals.

## Edits by network label

- Shared Services Canada: 30,065
- Canadian Department of National Defence: 9,348
- Canadian House of Commons: 5,080
- Canadian Broadcasting Corporation: 4,104
- Environment Canada: 3,403
- Shared Services Canada network (AS2665): 1,981
- Industry Canada: 1,533
- Shared Services Canada network (AS2675): 1,311

## Pages

- [Search the archive](https://revisionhistory.ca/): full-text search with filters by year, wiki, network, address and topic
- [Edits by year](https://revisionhistory.ca/years.html): one summary page per year
- [Methodology](https://revisionhistory.ca/methodology.html): collection, labelling, provenance and limits
- [FAQ](https://revisionhistory.ca/faq.html): what the data does and does not show
- [Data and verification](https://revisionhistory.ca/data.html): downloads, checksums and how to cite
- [Coverage](https://revisionhistory.ca/coverage.html): which wikis can be checked for government network traffic, and which cannot
- [Roadmap](https://revisionhistory.ca/roadmap.html): what is done, in progress, planned and parked
- [Address clusters](https://revisionhistory.ca/clusters.html): which addresses behave as one network exit and which blocks replaced which

Cite as: Revision History (revisionhistory.ca), Prime Rogue Inc. For a specific edit, cite the Wikipedia diff as the primary source.
